title_zh: 依社团规则暂缓人数不足的表决

scenario.label_zh: 依社团规则暂缓人数不足的表决
scenario.goal_zh: 核对出席人数与法定人数，并决定先交换意见而等第四名成员到场再表决

context_zh: 虚构摄影社委员会开会，秘书拿出社团现行规则核对表决程序。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Chair
sentences.text: Only three committee members are here. Can we approve the equipment purchase now?

sentences.speaker: Secretary
sentences.text: Our rules say four members constitute a quorum for spending decisions.

sentences.speaker: Chair
sentences.text: Could we confer about the options while we wait, without taking a vote?

sentences.speaker: Secretary
sentences.text: Yes. Discussion is allowed, but the decision-making rule still applies to approval.

sentences.speaker: Chair
sentences.text: Then we will compare the two quotes now and wait for the fourth member before voting.

sentences.speaker: Secretary
sentences.text: I'll record that no purchase has been approved at this point.
